items.title: 14.11 Methods and techniques to measure and monitor air quality (air quality napne ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.11, printed page 316.

blocks.text: Air quality ko measure (napne) aur monitor (nazar rakhne) ke liye kai methods aur techniques mila kar istemal hoti hain, taake hawa mein different (alag alag) pollutants ki concentration maloom ho. In pollutants mein particulate matter (PM), nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), sulphur dioxide (SO₂), carbon monoxide (CO), ozone (O₃) aur volatile organic compounds (VOCs) shamil hain. Environmental engineers air quality ko sahi napne ke liye kai methods aur techniques istemal karte hain.

Air quality index (AQI) napne wala instrument (aala) nephelometer hai. Is se dhool, dhuan, mist (halki dhund) aur fumes jaise PM ko monitor kiya jata hai. Nephelometer ko photometer bhi kehte hain; yeh particles ko is tarah pehchanta hai ke woh light ko kitna scatter (bikherte) karte hain; yeh scattered light ki total amount napta hai.

blocks.prompt: Nephelometer kya napta hai, aur kis principle (usool) par?
blocks.explanation: Yeh PM (dhool, dhuan, mist, fumes) napta hai. Hawa ke sample se light guzari jati hai aur particles se bikhri hui total light napi jati hai; zyada light bikhre to matlab zyada PM.

items: Monitoring mein PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃ aur VOCs ki concentration napi jati hai.
Nephelometer (photometer) particles se bikhri light naap kar PM napta hai.
